recognize_zh: 周邊血中數顆小到中型淋巴球，胞質少量但深嗜鹼性，核圓或略不規則，箭頭所指的細胞核緻密且胞質藍色邊緣明顯，是 T-PLL 的小細胞型態。
features: Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Scant to moderate intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm (arrow)
One cell with irregular, elongated nuclear outline and cytoplasmic protrusion
Normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant to moderate and intensely basophilic without granules (arrow), and one cell shows an irregular nuclear outline with a cytoplasmic protrusion. No smudge cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, including its small-cell variant; flow cytometry and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have coarse block-like chromatin, pale scant cytoplasm and smudge cells, with a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and less basophilic cytoplasm, typically CD7 and CD26 negative.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a CD8+/CD57+ phenotype.
